items.question: How many of the known purifications should a practitioner perform?
premises: Purifications are known in this way.
Among them one is to be performed.
The instruction selects a single purification.
items.inference: A practitioner should perform exactly one of the known purifications.
uncertainties: The verse does not identify which specific purification is to be performed.
items.plain_english: Thus these purifications are known; among them, one should indeed perform one.
